what_works: Cream background, charcoal type, documentary-style product photography shot in actual workshop light (not studio) — and playfully named nav items ('clayplayers,' 'bringmeahigherlove') give the page personality without any decorative graphic. A woman-owned cleaning or painting brand can lift the warmth and the 'name the navigation like a human' move directly.
what_does_not_translate: The handcrafted ampersand and any custom lettering are real design work — substitute a humanist serif at small caps for the wordmark.
type_observations: One clean humanist sans throughout in two weights; the only typographic personality lives in the wordmark and the nav copy itself.
